title: Mr. Mori's 3D look
question: Mori's test model went through the Meshy workflow from a chibi picture made locally (FLUX.2 Klein) instead of ChatGPT. Keep that look, or redo the chibi pictures in ChatGPT like Eric's?

options.label: Make ChatGPT chibi pictures first, like Eric

decision: None of these; he gets too many points (Jørgen uses ~1050); don't waste credits; Mori 3D parked
